The main takeaway from our work is that

people who are identified ‘at risk’, whether it be for a rare genetic disorder like HD or for more common conditions such as cancer or diabetes, need support to adapt to the changes in their lives that may result from the risk information.
people who are living with chronic risk need support and information to help them understand the implications of their DNA test results.
